_comment: Canonical MCP servers shared by every coding harness. Rendered into Pi, Claude Code and Kiro by sync-mcp.sh. Never put secrets or internal URLs here: "command": "mcp-run" resolves to bin/mcp-run, which reads them from ~/.config/mcp/secrets.env. "secrets": true servers are only synced when that file exists. "autoApprove" is Kiro-only.
